plain_english_policy: Tax incentives for employers to offer employee childcare services.

effects.rationale: Indirectly supports childcare access by incentivizing private-sector provision, though not a direct subsidy or public program.
Relies on employer-provided childcare rather than government-run services.
Tax credits disproportionately benefit businesses (likely larger ones) with the capacity to offer benefits, not all employers or low-income workers.

evidence_quote: "Provide tax credits for businesses that provide child care"
